method: All rows of nea-supermarket-licences.csv, unchanged, plus OneMap geocode columns. Query is the 6-digit postal_code (zero padded); a result matches when POSTAL equals it. exact: all matches within 1 m; ambiguous: matches more than 1 m apart, first used; unmatched: no match. Coordinates are SVY21 (EPSG:3414) X/Y and WGS84 lat/long from OneMap.
purpose: Licensed supermarket locations; clipped to Queenstown (plus buffer) by build_queenstown_geography.R.
